milestones.title: DPR preparation authorised
milestones.description: Karnataka authorised preparation of Phase II DPRs, including RV Road - Bommasandra.
milestones.comments: Permission to prepare the DPR, not submission or approval of the completed DPR.

milestones.title: Karnataka project approval
milestones.description: State approval for Bangalore Metro Phase II, including RV Road - Bommasandra, under government order UDD 179 PRJ 2011.

milestones.title: Union Cabinet approval
milestones.description: The Union Cabinet approved Phase II, explicitly including RV Road - Bommasandra.
milestones.comments: The five-year completion period was envisaged from commencement of work, not from this approval date.

milestones.title: Formal Union sanction
milestones.description: The Ministry of Urban Development conveyed Government of India approval for implementation of Phase II.
milestones.comments: Separate from the January Cabinet decision.

milestones.title: Major civil contracts awarded
milestones.description: BMRCL records June 2017 awards for the three civil packages. ITD CEMINDIA JV covered packages 1 and 2; HCC-URC JV covered Bommanahalli - RV Road.
milestones.comments: Specialist reporting instead dates packages 1 and 2 to April 2017. Exact award days and the distinction between selection, LOA and agreement remain unresolved. June is the month recorded by BMRCL, not an established exact award date.

milestones.title: Package 1 piling begins
milestones.description: Piling for the first pier reportedly began in August 2017.
milestones.comments: Exact day not established. This is the earliest physical activity found in the supplied research, not proof of the first work anywhere on the corridor.

milestones.title: First pier reported complete
milestones.description: Contemporaneous specialist reporting documented the first Yellow Line pier near Electronic City, with photographs.
milestones.comments: The supplied research uses the report date. A separate contractor record establishing the precise casting day has not been obtained.

milestones.title: Package 2 final viaduct segment launched
milestones.description: The final segment of the approximately 6.385-km package 2 viaduct was launched in April 2021.
milestones.comments: The 11 April report refers to the preceding Tuesday; an exact day is not stored. This is a viaduct milestone, not completion of stations or systems.

milestones.title: Phased opening plan reported
milestones.revised_target: June 2023: Bommasandra - Central Silk Board; December 2023: Central Silk Board - RV Road
milestones.description: BMRCL linked the feasibility of a phased opening to rolling-stock availability.
milestones.comments: Reporting date; exact announcement day not established. The two sections did not share a June deadline.

milestones.title: Package 3 final segment launched
milestones.description: HCC-URC completed its final viaduct segment launch in September 2022.
milestones.comments: The 17 September report says 'last week'; its publication day is not the construction event date.

milestones.title: Full-corridor opening plan replaces phased plan
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD announced that the corridor would open in one go.
milestones.comments: Reporting date; exact interview day and the reason for changing the opening configuration need confirmation.

milestones.title: February 2024 opening expectation announced
milestones.description: An MP announced an expected opening, dependent on train availability and trials.
milestones.comments: An announced expectation, not regulatory authorisation or a confirmed opening date.

milestones.title: Opening target moves to year-end
milestones.previous_target: February 2024 expectation; other reporting mentioned July 2024
milestones.description: Reporting described a revised year-end target, with train availability a principal dependency.
milestones.comments: Precise announcement provenance and intervening targets are not fully established.

milestones.title: First confirmed mainline movement
milestones.description: The first slow trial movement left Hebbagodi depot, with departure reported at 18:55.
milestones.comments: A limited-section movement, not evidence of full-corridor testing or completion of signalling integration.

milestones.title: Civil work and track installation reported complete
milestones.description: Officials described civil work as complete, tracks and signalling installed, and rail grinding finished.
milestones.comments: Completion was reported by this date; no exact completion day or formal certificate is established. Full-line third-rail energisation was still anticipated by May-end.

milestones.title: First reported full-corridor trial run
milestones.description: A train ran the full route, stopping at intermediate stations.
milestones.comments: Does not establish the start or completion of the entire integrated signalling test programme.

milestones.title: RDSO oscillation and emergency-braking trials begin
milestones.description: BMRCL announced a roughly 12-14-day oscillation and EBD trial programme.
milestones.comments: Testing commencement, not clearance. The announced scope must not be expanded to the entire corridor.

milestones.title: January 2025 opening plan reported
milestones.description: BMRCL envisaged inspection in December and sufficient trains by November-December; civil and systems work was described as substantially complete.
milestones.comments: Conditional plan. Exact release day and final completion certificates are not established.

milestones.title: Reduced-fleet opening considered
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD said a reduced-fleet opening was being considered.
milestones.comments: An exploratory option, not a fixed launch announcement. Interview day unspecified.

milestones.title: RDSO train-design clearance reported
milestones.description: A BMRCL official subsequently said RDSO cleared the new train design on this date.
milestones.comments: Reported technical clearance; the underlying document remains unlocated. Not passenger-opening authorisation.

milestones.title: May 2025 opening target stated
milestones.description: The Deputy CM stated the May target in the Assembly. Rolling-stock shortage was identified as a delay factor.
milestones.comments: Statement reported on 10 March; the event date is 4 March.

milestones.title: Opening forecast moves beyond May
milestones.description: Statutory rolling-stock and multi-train tests were reported conducted, while ISA/signalling assessment remained pending.
milestones.comments: Reporting date and forecast, not a formally fixed opening date or exact test-completion date.

milestones.title: ISA certification reportedly issued
milestones.description: Contemporary reporting on Saturday 19 July says certification was issued on Thursday; BMRCL confirmed receipt of the ISA report.
milestones.comments: 17 July is derived from the explicit weekday reference. A retrospective instead gives 19 July. The conflict remains unresolved pending the certificate.

milestones.title: Mid-August opening expectation reported
milestones.description: A former BMRCL MD expected an opening by mid-August, conditional on certification and inspection.
milestones.comments: A reported expectation; exact announcement day is not established.

milestones.title: CMRS corridor inspection
milestones.description: The safety commissioner inspected the corridor over this interval, according to reporting based on the inspection report.
milestones.comments: Separate from earlier train-only inspections.

milestones.title: Dated CMRS report and conditional authorisation
milestones.description: Reporting identifies a safety report dated 30 July permitting GoA-2 operation with drivers, rather than unattended GoA-4 operation.
milestones.comments: Another account gives 1 August as the clearance date. The signed report and opening order are needed to resolve this. ATS integration, training, manuals and cybersecurity validation were among outstanding matters.

milestones.title: August 10 inauguration announced
milestones.description: A Union minister announced the inauguration date.
milestones.comments: Ceremonial target; ordinary passenger services began on August 11.

milestones.title: Yellow Line inaugurated
milestones.description: The Prime Minister inaugurated the Yellow Line.
milestones.comments: Ceremonial opening; distinct from the following day's passenger-service commencement.

milestones.title: Passenger operations begin
milestones.description: Commercial services began, with the first departure reported at 06:30. A reporter travelled on the first service.
